headline: PIF Secures Inaugural S&P A+ Credit Rating with Stable Outlook
summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund has been assigned an inaugural A+ long-term foreign and local currency issuer credit rating with a stable outlook by S&P Global Ratings.
why: Sovereign wealth fund credit ratings establish international borrowing benchmarks and reflect institutional financial strength and investment strategy credibility.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: An inaugural investment-grade rating enhances the fund's international borrowing profile.
